metadata.title: Missing You — memories with gentle proof
metadata.description: A calm place to write about people you miss. Your words stay private off-chain; a cryptographic proof can be anchored on-chain.

footer.tagline: Missing You — preserving memories with care.

home.headline: Preserve a memory with proof that it existed.
home.subhead: A calm place for memories that matter. Keep the full story private in our database, and anchor only the proof on-chain — so you can verify without exposing what you wrote.

step1.title: Write from the heart
step1.body: Capture what you remember in a quiet, unhurried editor. Your words are stored securely off-chain.

step2.title: Create a canonical proof
step2.body: We build a stable fingerprint of your entry — not the prose itself — so the same memory always produces the same hash.

step3.title: Anchor when you are ready
step3.body: Optionally anchor that fingerprint on-chain. Later, anyone can verify the memory against the blockchain without seeing private content.

privacy.title: Privacy-first by design
privacy.body: Journal content stays off-chain. The chain holds only identifiers and cryptographic commitments — never your full letter, story, or diary entry.
